# Container Adjacent Charts

Blockquote horizontal chart immediately after text.

> before h
> ```mdf-bar-chart
> A,1
> B,2
> ```

Blockquote horizontal chart after blank quote line.

> before blank h
>
> ```mdf-bar-chart
> A,1
> B,2
> ```

List horizontal chart immediately after text.

- before h
  ```mdf-bar-chart
  A,1
  B,2
  ```

List horizontal chart after blank list line.

- before blank h

  ```mdf-bar-chart
  A,1
  B,2
  ```
